name: container_sync_secret_mixed
about: A set with a secret created through a Deeploy oracle on older code, with one consumer on older code. Init with --arm next --arm-of r1s-02=old --arm-of r1w-03=old --docker-nodes r1w-01,r1w-02,r1w-03 and Deeploy on r1s-01 and r1s-02. Set S2 (key lnet-sync-k2, secret of set s2) is created through r1s-02 (old code): consumers on r1w-02 (next) and r1w-03 (old), then the provider on r1w-01 (next), which publishes twice, 90 s apart. Checks: custody of the three jobs (the stored copy holds only the dAuth placeholder; 0 bytes of the variable in the apps on next, the count on old is reported); r1w-02 applies both publishes within 150 s with the set's format and a 64-hex mac, while r1w-03 refuses the latest with the format line, before any download. Then r1w-03 moves to next and must apply the pending record at its next tick: read after the run from its sync history (its quarantine files from the older code are expected), with a secret scan for s2 last. Needs the trees next and old staged and the image redis:7-alpine on this machine.
